'''Wellam Adarios''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Shortly after the Imperial [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] on a [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda I]], Adarios was stationed in orbit of the planet [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]] as captain of the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Eternal Wrath]]''.<ref name="OAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wellam Adarios first appeared in ''[[Onslaught at Arda I]]'', an adventure module for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game released in [[2014]]. It is possible for players to run into the ''Eternal Wrath'' while they travel to Ord Radama, but only if they fail to make a specified course correction. If they do they must persuade the ship's crew to let them pass despite having outdated access codes, otherwise Adarios calls for them to be brought aboard for questioning and sends [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to destroy them if they try to escape. This article assumes that players were successful and so did not encounter the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] or its captain.
